_comment: ИТОГОВАЯ ТОЧКА (point3): дефолты ядра + EMAPeriod 30, StopDailyATR 1.25, DailyATRPeriod 3; гейт стохастика, STUCK и PROFIT выключены. EMA 600 — потолок: Lookback 2·600+20 = 1220 баров ≈ 4.5% окна, прогрев целиком после дыры. Запуск (строго последовательно): полное окно — go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker YDEX -strategy rsi_zone -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_zone/ydex/point.json -out ./reports/YDEX_zone/r20261006/point3_full -months 24 -min-trades 1 -metric profit_factor; walk-forward 24/12/3 — go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker YDEX -strategy rsi_zone -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_zone/ydex/point.json -out ./reports/YDEX_zone/r20261006/point3_wf -months 24 -train-months 12 -test-months 3 -min-trades 1 -metric profit_factor; контроль 24/15/3 — go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker YDEX -strategy rsi_zone -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_zone/ydex/point.json -out ./reports/YDEX_zone/r20261006/point3_ctrl -months 24 -train-months 15 -test-months 3 -min-trades 1 -metric profit_factor; удвоенная комиссия -commission 0.001 — go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker YDEX -strategy rsi_zone -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_zone/ydex/point.json -out ./reports/YDEX_zone/r20261006/point3_comm -months 24 -train-months 12 -test-months 3 -min-trades 1 -commission 0.001 -metric profit_factor.
